solution.title: Precision doesn't come from the device; it comes from harmony.
solution.side: Crown fit depends on the sync of three elements: printer, resin, curing. We calibrate all three together and deliver with field expertise — even on other brand devices you own.

curing.title: Not just the printer. Curing completes the result.
curing.side: Printing isn't finished when it leaves the device. Improperly cured work fails even if printed correctly. Here are three reasons:
curing.reason1Desc: Undercuring means brittleness — the most common invisible cause of frequent fracture in temporary crowns and bridges.
curing.reason2Desc: Overcuring shrinks and deforms the material. The ±20 µm gained on the printer is lost in the curing unit.
curing.reason3Desc: Correct degree of conversion prevents monomer release; ensures shade stability and patient safety.

roi.desc: A clinic switching to the 3mash ecosystem has the potential to recover its investment in under 6 months. Thereafter, this efficiency continues every year: up to $72–162K/year savings potential.

ecosystem.title: Every part of the digital workflow, under one roof.

trust.title: Why do leading labs produce with us?
trust.side: The short answer is always the same: consistency. 580+ dental labs and clinics produce with this system because the outcome is identical every time.
